message.content:
Yes—**the United States (U.S.) is geographically situated within the continent of North America**.  

### Quick facts  
| Item | Detail |
|------|--------|
| **Continent** | North America |
| **Geographic region** | Northern Hemisphere, Western Hemisphere |
| **Neighboring land borders** | Canada (north), Mexico (south) |
| **Major bodies of water** | Atlantic Ocean (east), Pacific Ocean (west), Gulf of Mexico (southeast) |
| **Time zones** | Eastern, Central, Mountain, Pacific, Alaska, Hawaii-Aleutian, plus several others for territories |

So when people refer to “North American” nations, the U.S. is one of the three primary ones alongside Canada and Mexico. If you’re looking into specific aspects—like climate zones across states, economic ties within NAFTA/USMCA, or cultural regions—just let me know!
